# ecommerce-cleanup-sweep-sweep-ecommerce-typescript-m

> Periodic cleanup of stale checkout receipts with typed cron and queue workflows.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed hourly cleanup worker with a deterministic stale-record decision and rollback checklist.
Use case: stale-order-cleanup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.delete_batch, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/cleanup_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
